name: The Fool
upright: Something new is asking for a yes before you've worked out the how. Today favours the first step over the full map.
Travel light today. Leave the "what ifs" at the door and let curiosity lead; you'll learn more by starting than by planning.
A small leap of faith goes further than you expect. Say yes to the invitation, the idea, or the detour.
Pack light and leave early. Today rewards whoever's willing to wander a little.
Say yes first and figure out the details on the way. You're more adaptable than you think.
Your inner kid has a good idea today. Let them pick the plan.
Try the thing you'd normally talk yourself out of. Worst case, it's a good story.
Curiosity is your compass today. Follow whatever makes you go "huh, interesting".
Don't wait to feel ready. Ready usually shows up halfway through.
An unplanned conversation or detour could turn out to be the best part of the day.
Lightness is a strength today. Don't take everything so seriously.
Begin before you're good at it. That's how everyone gets good.
The road ahead isn't fully lit, but the next step is. Take that one.
Trust that you'll figure it out. You always have before.
Let go of the script for the day and improvise a little.
New beginnings feel wobbly. That's not a warning sign; that's just what new feels like.
Open hands catch more than clenched ones. Stay open to whatever turns up.
Treat today like the first page of something. Write a good opening line.
If a plan feels a little too sensible today, add one small adventure to it and see what happens.
You don't need the whole route mapped. Pick a direction that feels exciting and trust yourself to adjust.
reversed: Check the ground before you jump. Enthusiasm is great; skipping the boring details isn't.
You might be holding back from something new out of fear of looking foolish. Everyone's a beginner once, so give yourself permission to be one.
Pause before the impulse buy, the hot take, or the 2am decision. Tomorrow-you will thank you.
A little caution goes a long way today. Read the fine print before you sign up.
You're itching for change but not sure where to start. Pick the smallest version.
Spontaneity is fun until it costs you. Keep one foot on the ground.
Hesitating at the edge is normal. Ask what you're actually afraid of.
Not every shiny new thing deserves your attention. Choose one.
Risk-taking without a safety net could catch up with you. Pack the umbrella.
You might be waiting for a perfect moment that won't come. Good enough is fine.
Someone's carefree attitude may be leaving you to clean up. Say something.
Overthinking has replaced doing. Take one tiny step and see how it feels.
A false start isn't failure. Reset and try again tomorrow.
Your gut's urging caution about a new venture. Listen, then decide.
Feeling naive about something? Ask questions; it's how you learn.
Stop scrolling for inspiration and start something, however small.
A missed opportunity stings, but another will come. Be ready this time.
Wanting freedom is fair. Running from responsibility is a different thing.
Slow down your yes today. Make sure it's yours and not just excitement.
Before you jump, take one minute to ask, "What's the worst that could realistically happen?" Then decide.

name: The Magician
upright: You already have everything you need on the table. Today's about putting it to work, not waiting for more.
Your words carry extra weight today. Pitch the idea, send the message, make the case.
Focus turns intention into results. Pick one thing and give it your full attention.
You've got the tools. Today's job is to pick one up and use it.
Ideas become real when you act on them. Make the first move.
Your skills are sharper than you give yourself credit for. Show them off.
Communication is your strong suit today. Send the email you've been drafting.
Concentrate your energy and things move quickly. Scattered effort won't.
Today is good for starting something you can actually finish.
Resourcefulness wins. Make do with what's in front of you.
A small bit of initiative now sets the tone for the whole week.
Confidence is contagious. Walk in like you know what you're doing.
Everything you need is closer than it looks. Check what you already have.
Make a plan, then make it happen. In that order, but quickly.
Your words can open doors today. Ask for what you want.
Get creative with your resources. The clever solution is the simple one.
Take stock of what's already on your desk, in your bag or in your contacts list. The solution is probably there.
Turn one idea into one action before lunch. Momentum loves an early start.
Speak with intention today. Clear, confident words get things moving faster than hinting.
A skill you've been quietly building is ready for its debut. Show someone what you can do.
reversed: Talent without direction just spins its wheels. Get clear on what you actually want before you start.
Watch for smooth talk, from others or from yourself. If something sounds too slick, look under the hood.
You might be underselling what you can do. Try the thing you're quietly sure you'd be good at.
All the ingredients, no recipe. Decide what you're making before you start.
Someone may be all talk today. Judge by actions, not promises.
You're holding back your talents out of self-doubt. Let them out.
Too many projects, too little focus. Pick one and give it everything.
Watch for manipulation, from others or your own convenient excuses.
Plans are stalling because the first step feels too big. Shrink it.
Don't overpromise today. Deliver what you said you would.
Your energy's leaking into a dozen directions. Plug the holes.
Feeling like an imposter? You earned your seat at the table.
Clever words won't fix a weak plan. Shore up the foundations.
Don't let someone else's charisma talk you into something.
Good intentions need follow-through. Pick one and see it through today.
Check your motives. Are you acting for the right reasons?
Your power is in your hands, not someone else's approval. Take it back.
You've got the ability but not the plan. Spend ten minutes deciding what "done" looks like.
Someone's pitch sounds brilliant but light on detail. Ask one practical question before you buy in.
You're quietly sabotaging your own talent with "I'm not ready". Try it anyway and see.

name: The High Priestess
upright: Your gut already knows. Today, listen more than you talk and notice what keeps coming back to you.
Not everything needs to be said out loud yet. Sit with what you know and let it settle.
Pay attention to dreams, hunches and small coincidences today. Quiet signals are worth tuning into.
Answers come in the quiet today. Leave some space in your schedule.
You know more than you're letting on, even to yourself. Trust it.
Watch, listen, wait. The right moment to act will be obvious.
Your first impression of someone today is probably right.
Not everything needs to be explained. Some things you just know.
A calm mind sees further. Take five minutes of stillness before deciding.
Keep your cards close today. Not every plan needs announcing.
Mystery isn't a problem to solve right now. Let it unfold.
Pay attention to what your body is telling you. It's wise.
Journal before bed. Your subconscious has something to say.
Someone's unspoken feelings are clearer than their words. Read between the lines.
A good day for learning something esoteric, odd or deep.
Your intuition is like a muscle. Use it today and notice what it gets right.
When a choice feels unclear, wait a beat. The quiet answer usually arrives before the loud one.
Notice the detail everyone else skips over. Your observation could be the key today.
A hunch about a person or situation is worth taking seriously, even if you can't explain it yet.
Give yourself an hour with no input, no podcasts and no scrolling. See what thoughts surface.
reversed: You're second-guessing an instinct you'd normally trust. Turn the noise down and check in with yourself.
Something's being kept under wraps. You don't need to dig, but don't ignore the feeling that there's more to it.
Too much time in your own head can blur things. Talk it through with someone you trust.
You're tuning out your gut because the logic looks neater. Check in with both.
Secrets have a way of surfacing. Be ready for a reveal.
Too much noise is drowning your inner voice. Turn something off.
You might be withholding something that should be shared.
Overanalysing your intuition kills it. Feel first, think second.
Someone may be hiding their true intentions. Stay observant.
Disconnected from yourself lately? Do something just for you.
Don't let others' opinions override what you already know.
You're ignoring a recurring dream or hunch. Pay attention.
Surface-level answers won't satisfy you today. Go deeper.
You're craving certainty in an uncertain situation. Breathe through it.
Something feels off but you can't name it. Give it time; it'll clarify.
You've been asking everyone for advice except yourself. Try writing down what you actually think.
A feeling you've been brushing off keeps returning. Sit with it for five minutes and listen.
Too much information is drowning out your instincts. Close a few tabs, literally and mentally.
Something is being left unsaid in a conversation. Gently ask what's really going on.
Your intuition is quieter when you're exhausted. Rest first, then trust your gut.

name: The Empress
upright: Today is good for making things grow: a project, a friendship, a pot plant. Give it a bit of care and watch it respond.
Lean into comfort and good things. A nice meal, a walk outside or time with people you love is well spent.
Creativity flows easily right now. Make something just for the joy of making it.
Abundance is all around you today. Notice the small luxuries.
Nurture something, whether a project, a person or yourself. It'll flourish.
Treat your senses today: good food, soft clothes, nice music.
Creative juices are flowing. Make, bake, build or write.
Comfort isn't laziness. Give yourself permission to enjoy it.
Plant a seed, literal or figurative. Good things are growing.
Be generous with your warmth today. It comes back tenfold.
Beauty is worth your time. Make something look or feel nice.
A good day for hosting, feeding or looking after people.
Self-care is productive. Book the thing, take the bath, rest.
Let things grow at their own pace. You can't rush a garden.
You're more capable of creating than you think. Start something today.
Give something in your life a bit of extra care today, whether a plant, a friendship or a half-finished project.

Creative ideas want to grow. Give one of them twenty minutes of your attention.

A creative block isn't a dead end; it's a sign to rest the soil. Step away and come back fresh.
Watch for smothering, whether giving it or receiving it. Support works best with a little breathing room.
Giving too much leaves you running on empty. Take care of yourself too.
Creativity feels stuck. Step away and play instead of produce.
Clinging too tightly to someone could smother them. Give space.
You're neglecting your own needs. Put yourself on the list.
Overindulgence might leave you feeling flat. Moderation helps.
A project isn't growing because you're forcing it. Ease off.
Your environment feels uninspiring. Change one small thing.
Don't confuse busyness with productivity. Rest is part of creating.
Dependence on others' approval is draining. Back yourself.
Insecurity is blocking your creativity. Make something messy on purpose.
Physical self-care slipped. Water, food, sleep, in that order.
Someone's dependence on you is getting heavy. Set a boundary.
You've been in the nest too long. Venture out a little.
Comparison steals the joy of creating. Make for yourself.
Overthinking your creative work stops it flowing. Just begin.
You've been looking after everyone but yourself. Pick one small thing that's purely for you today.
A creative project has stalled. Rest it for a day rather than forcing it.

name: The Emperor
upright: A bit of structure goes a long way today. Make the list, set the boundary, build the routine.

If you feel powerless, find one area you can take charge of today and start there.

Discipline slipped recently. Restart gently, with no guilt, just one small habit today.
Someone may test your boundaries. Hold the line kindly but firmly.
Working longer hours to feel in control won't fix the real problem. Step back and plan instead.
Ask yourself: am I holding on to this rule because it helps, or because letting go feels scary?

name: The Hierophant
upright: There's wisdom in the tried-and-true today. Ask someone who's been there, or lean on a routine that works.

A mentor or teacher could offer exactly the guidance you need.
Rituals ground you. Light a candle, make the tea, sit with it.

Faith in something bigger than yourself, whatever that looks like for you, steadies you today.

Revisit a ritual you've let slide, like Sunday pancakes, a weekly call or a morning stretch. It anchors the week.
reversed: "That's how it's always been done" isn't a reason. Question the habit that no longer fits.
You don't have to follow the crowd on this one. Trust your own read.
Breaking from convention is fine, but do it on purpose, not just to be contrary.
Rebelling for the sake of it won't get you far. Rebel with purpose.
An old institution or routine feels stifling. Shake it up.
Not every tradition deserves keeping. Choose deliberately.
A mentor's advice doesn't fit. Take what's useful, leave the rest.
Question your assumptions about "how things should be".
Your spiritual or personal beliefs are shifting. Let them.
You may be outgrowing a group, belief or routine. It's okay to let it change.
Forge your own path today. Convention isn't serving you on this one.
Someone's lecturing you. You can listen respectfully without agreeing.
Breaking tradition works best with a purpose. Know what you're breaking towards.
An institution or system feels stifling. Find the small freedom within it.
Trust your own judgement over someone else's rulebook today.
Peer pressure is real. Make your choice on your own terms.
Doing something differently doesn't mean doing it wrong.
You can respect where an idea came from and still decide it isn't for you.
Write your own rulebook for one small area of life. What would you keep, and what would you scrap?
If a group's expectations feel tight, look for one person in it who thinks like you do.

name: The Lovers
upright: Connection is the theme today. Lean into the people who feel like home.
A choice is in front of you. Pick the option that matches who you actually are, not who you think you should be.
Harmony comes easily when you're honest. Say the warm thing you've been meaning to say.
Choose with your heart today, and back it up with your head.
Values alignment matters. Surround yourself with people who share yours.
A partnership, in love, friendship or work, flourishes today.
Be honest about what you want. Clarity attracts the right things.
A big decision is easier when you know what you stand for.
Your relationships reflect your values. Nurture the good ones.
A conversation with someone close could deepen your connection. Be a little more open than usual.
Spend time with people who share your values. You'll leave feeling more like yourself.
A partnership, whether romantic, creative or work, finds its rhythm today. Lean into it.
Tell someone what they mean to you. It costs nothing and could make their week.
A big decision gets easier when you ask, "Which choice is most me?"

Opposites can make a great team. Let your differences complement each other.
Commit to something you genuinely care about, not just something convenient.
Love in all its forms, from friends and family to pets and passions, is the theme today.
A small act of honesty in a relationship today will deepen trust more than a grand gesture.

reversed: Something feels out of sync, maybe with someone else or with your own values. Notice it before patching it over.
You're torn between two paths. Sleeping on it is allowed.
Don't let a disagreement turn into a standoff. Meet halfway where you can.
A choice is causing inner conflict. Take time to get clear.
Communication breakdown with someone close. Reach out first.
Feeling disconnected? Small gestures rebuild connection.
You're avoiding a choice by keeping all options open. Close a door.
Being true to yourself might disappoint someone. That's okay.
A partnership needs a reset. Talk about what's working and what isn't.
A choice is causing inner conflict. Give yourself a day to get clear before committing.
Notice where your actions and values have drifted apart. Small corrections help.
Communication with someone close feels strained. Reach out first with something warm.
Don't make a big relationship or life decision out of fear today.
Feeling disconnected? A small gesture, like a message, a coffee or a hug, can rebuild the bridge.
Temptation is pulling you away from what you actually want. Remember the bigger picture.
Keeping every option open is its own decision. Close one door so another can open properly.
Trust feels shaky. Ask the direct question instead of assuming the worst.
Harmony built on silence won't last. Say the honest thing, kindly.
A rift can be mended. Be the one who makes the first move.
If you're saying yes to keep the peace, check whether it's costing you something important.

name: The Chariot
upright: Full steam ahead. You have the drive today; point it somewhere specific and go.
Opposing pulls can still move you forward if you keep a firm grip on the reins.
Determination beats talent today. Keep showing up and the win follows.
You're steering the ship. Keep a firm hand on the wheel.
A road trip, literal or figurative, calls. Hit the road.
Obstacles are just part of the route. Drive through them.
Harness competing priorities and make them pull together.
Your drive is strong today. Point it at one clear goal and don't look back.
Victory comes through focus. Pick the thing that matters and give it everything.
Two competing priorities can both move forward if you keep a firm hand on the plan.

A trip, a commute or a move goes smoothly today. Enjoy the forward motion.
Treat obstacles as part of the route, not reasons to turn back.

Set a destination and drive towards it with confidence.
You're closer to the finish line than it feels. Keep your eyes forward.
Believe in yourself like you'd believe in a friend. That belief is fuel.
Take control of a situation that's been drifting. You're more than capable.
Aim a little higher than usual. Your ambition is well placed today.
Distractions are just scenery. Keep driving.
reversed: You're pushing hard but going in circles. Stop, check the map, then go again.
Too many directions at once means none of them get finished. Pick one.
Forcing it isn't working. Ease off the accelerator and let things line up.
Lack of direction makes effort feel pointless. Choose a goal.
Effort without direction feels pointless. Choose one goal before pushing harder.
Pulled in two directions? Pick one for today and park the other.
Aggression won't get you there faster. Calm, steady pressure will.
If you're losing control, hand over what isn't really yours to steer.
Self-discipline has slipped. Restart with one small, achievable task.
An obstacle looks bigger than it is. Look at it from a different angle.
Feeling stuck? Change your route, not your destination.
Pushing without rest leads to burnout. Schedule a pit stop.
Someone else is steering your day. Take back the wheel politely.
Comparing your speed to others' is pointless. Focus on your own lane.
A detour isn't failure. It might show you a better road.
If you've lost sight of why you started, revisit it before pressing on.
Slowing down might actually get you there sooner, and with fewer bumps.
Too many goals means slow progress on all of them. Narrow your focus.
Ask yourself whether you're chasing the goal or just running away from standing still.
Rest the engine tonight. Tomorrow's drive will be smoother with a full tank.

name: Strength
upright: Quiet strength beats brute force today. Stay calm and steady and the hard thing softens.

Gentleness is stronger than force today. Lead with kindness.
Face the thing you've been avoiding. You can handle it.
Courage doesn't mean no fear. It means doing it anyway.
Be compassionate with someone who's struggling, including yourself.

Endurance beats intensity. Pace yourself and you'll go the distance.

Don't let other people's intensity overwhelm you. Protect your calm.
Ask yourself what you'd tell a friend who felt this unsure. Then tell yourself.
